subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Inscrutable
solution:
The correct answer is **'Comprehensible'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Inscrutable** is an adjective which means impossible to understand or interpret.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Comprehensible **- able to be understood; intelligible.
 
• **Enigmatic **- difficult to interpret or understand; mysterious.
 
• **Amiable **- having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner.
 
• **Appropriate **- suitable or proper in the circumstances.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that **comprehensible **is the correct antonym for the word **inscrutable**.
 
• Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
